tools.title: Online Tools
tools.description: A quiet set of practical browser tools with no account required. Tune your rhythm and keep your attention for what matters.
tools.metaDescription: iceaxing's online toolbox, with a focused Pomodoro timer and other privacy-minded browser utilities.
tools.privacyTitle: Your settings stay on this device
tools.privacyDescription: These tools run in your browser. Preferences and sessions are stored locally and are not uploaded to the site server.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.description: Build a clear rhythm between focus and rest. Customize every interval and cycle, then return to a calm local clock when the timer is idle.

smithChart.title: Smith Chart
smithChart.description: A precision vector Smith chart for impedance transformation, transmission-line analysis, matching synthesis, and export.

smithChart.title: Smith Chart
smithChart.description: Plot terminal impedance on a professional vector scale, inspect every RF quantity, move along a transmission line, and synthesize practical stub or L-network matches.
smithChart.metaDescription: Interactive professional Smith chart for impedance and admittance, reflection coefficient, VSWR, return loss, transmission-line transforms, stub matching, L networks, markers, and SVG or CSV export.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.description: Treat each focus session as a route you can finish. Set your pace, move forward, and recalibrate at every break.
pomodoro.metaDescription: A customizable online Pomodoro timer with focus, short and long breaks, cycles, local persistence, background correction, and completion alerts.
